guidance: Call /v1/cl/capture/start using POST method to initialize a new data capture. The body of the request should contain the CaptureStartRequest as defined in the API specification.

input.name: body
input.description: CaptureStartRequest object as defined in the API specification

output.name: response
output.description: CaptureStartResponse object as defined in the API specification

description: Run a configured UDP flood attack testcase
guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/run to execute a pre-configured UDP flood attack test. This API requires a valid session ID and a timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes, alongside the necessary body parameters.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for running the UDP flood attack test case

output.name: response
output.description: The response from running the UDP flood attack test case

description: Stop the data capture process
guidance: Call /v1/cl/capture/stop to stop the data capture, which requires a valid session_id and timestamp. The timestamp should be a Unix timestamp and is valid for 10 minutes.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for stopping the capture

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response body from the API

description: Search for the statistics history of a specified testcase instance
guidance: Use POST method to call /v1/cl/stats/search with necessary parameters. The timestamp must be a Unix timestamp and is valid only for 10 minutes. A session ID, obtained from a previous login, is also required.

input.name: body
input.description: The request body containing the search criteria as defined by statsapi.StatsSearchRequest

output.name: response
output.description: The response body as defined by statsapi.StatsSearchResponse

description: User logout
guidance: Call /v1/cl/user/logout to invalidate the current user session. This API requires a valid session_id and a timestamp (valid for 10 minutes). The request body should conform to the alps.UserLogoutRequest schema.

input.name: body
input.description: The request body as defined by alps.UserLogoutRequest

output.name: response
output.description: The response body as defined by alps.UserLogoutResponse

description: 用户登录以获取后续操作权限
guidance: 调用 /v1/cl/user/login 接口进行用户登录，此步骤需要提供一个在10分钟内有效的时间戳，并通过body传递登录请求参数。

input.name: login_request
input.description: 登录请求体，包含用户名和密码等信息

output.name: login_response
output.description: 登录响应体，包含session_id等信息

description: Search for DDoS attack profiles, specifically checking for UDP flood configurations
guidance: Use POST method to call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/profile/search with a valid session_id and timestamp (valid within 10 minutes). The request body should contain the necessary parameters as defined in AttackProfileSearchRequest.

input.name: body
input.description: request body following the schema of AttackProfileSearchRequest

output.name: response
output.description: The response body follows the schema of AttackProfileSearchResponse

description: Create DDoS attack profile template
guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/profile/create to create a DDoS attack profile. This step requires a valid session_id and timestamp, where the timestamp should be a Unix timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for creating DDoS attack profile

output.name: response
output.description: Response body from the API call

description: Create DDoS attack flow template
guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/create to create a DDoS attack flow template. This step requires a valid session ID and timestamp (valid within 10 minutes). The body of the request should contain details as per AttackFlowCreateRequest schema.

input.name: body
input.description: Details for creating DDoS attack flow as per AttackFlowCreateRequest schema

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response from the API after creating DDoS attack flow template

description: 启动一个数据包捕获会话以监控攻击效果
guidance: 通过POST请求调用/v1/cl/capture/start接口来启动一个新的数据包捕获会话。此步骤需要提供一个有效的session_id和当前时间戳（timestamp），其中timestamp为UNIX格式且在生成后的10分钟内有效。

input.name: body
input.description: request body for starting the capture, see #/definitions/captureapi.CaptureStartRequest for details

output.name: response
output.description: capture start response, see #/definitions/captureapi.CaptureStartResponse for details

description: Run a specified testcase with given session and timestamp
guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/run to execute a specific test case. The request should include a valid session_id, a timestamp (valid for 10 minutes), and the necessary body content as per the TestcaseRunRequest schema.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

output.name: response
output.description: Response from running the test case

description: Stop the packet capture process after completing an attack
guidance: Call /v1/cl/capture/stop using POST method to stop the ongoing packet capture. This step requires a valid session_id and a timestamp that is within 10 minutes of the current time.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: CaptureStopRequest object as defined in the API specification

output.name: response
output.description: CaptureStopResponse object as defined in the API specification

description: 获取安全攻击统计结果
guidance: 调用/v1/cl/security/attack/stats/result接口以获取UDP flood攻击的影响分析报告。此步骤需要提供一个有效期内的时间戳和会话ID，并通过body传递请求参数。

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: 请求体，包含StrikeStatsResultRequest定义的属性

output.name: response
output.description: 响应体，包含StrikeStatsResultResponse定义的属性

description: 用户注销
guidance: 调用 /v1/cl/user/logout 接口以注销当前用户。此步骤需要提供一个有效的 session_id 和一个未过期的 timestamp（有效期为10分钟）。请求体中还需要包含 UserLogoutRequest 对象。

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

output.name: response
output.description: UserLogoutResponse from response
